detail.name: Velina's Namecard
detail.desc: Get by unlocking Velina's Mindscape: Conquest by Etiquette
detail.desc2:
A business card bearing the image of the Administrative Director of the External Strategy Department.
Its design is elegant and restrained, with clean lines and not a trace of unnecessary flourish — neither overly familiar to the point of impropriety, nor so cold as to create a sense of distance. Every detail strikes a perfect balance. Among the elite of Roscaelifer, owning one is considered a mark of pride.
But when an ordinary video store owner accepts it as part of a routine exchange, they discover something unexpected — beneath the card lies another one. Written in neat, graceful handwriting is a private number, separate from the public line.
So... is this, too, some unspoken form of "special treatment"?
